title: What If the World Lost Its Entire Wheat Crop for a Year?

scenes.text: What if the world's wheat crop failed for a year? A fifth of humanity's calories would go missing.
Wheat supplies about 20 percent of all calories and 20 percent of all protein people eat.
Farmers grow about 811 million tons of it on 219 million hectares.
Across North Africa and Central and Western Asia, it gives more than a third of daily calories.
In 2022, losing just Ukraine's 6 percent of traded food calories already pushed wheat prices up worldwide.
Russia alone sells over 17 percent of the world's exported wheat, which shows how thin the safety net is.

description:
